messages.subject: Toyota Motor Thailand | External affairs, energy policy and next-generation mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Yamashita and Toyota Motor Thailand Leadership Team,

Toyota's External Affairs agenda in Thailand is especially relevant to my background. Your current work spans trade and investment, energy policy, environmental regulation and emerging mobility technologies, all areas where institutional coordination and disciplined execution matter.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead engagement with ministries, regulators, industry bodies and strategic stakeholders across mining, environment, energy, labour, aviation, standards, revenue, trade and investment matters. I also advise senior management on stakeholder risk and translate external requirements into internal action.

My energy-transition experience includes governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus carbon-data readiness built from operating evidence. I would bring Toyota a combination of policy fluency, industrial execution, ESG discipline and senior stakeholder management rather than a purely communications-led external-affairs profile.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, ASEAN or regional mandates in External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a Toyota-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the appropriate executive team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
